role: Practice Growth Specialist, SMB Customer Success
headline: Customer Success and Onboarding Specialist | Health Technology | MBBS-Trained Physician
summary: MBBS-trained physician with four years at Greenway Health, where I implemented and trained clinicians on healthcare software across close to 200 practices. I run onboarding calls and training sessions, learn clinicians' workflows and help them adopt new tools, and I feed what I hear back to product teams. I also run Roovero, my own SaaS, with paying pilot clients.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery and workflow documentation through go-live and follow-up.
Ran onboarding calls, demos and hands-on training for providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants (200+ trained), and followed up as practices settled in.
Worked with product teams on client issues and growth opportunities; grouped recurring pain points into PRDs and feature requests, and many shipped.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined personas and workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference (50 attendees).
skills: onboarding, launches, adoption, client check-ins, issue escalation, feedback into product
demos, training, stakeholder communication, workflow advice
AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini), React, GitHub, n8n; emergency, ICU and ambulatory workflows
